stem.en: Kabir swaps a surface polar bead for another polar bead and nothing happens. He says "so surface beads never matter". What does the sim show if he swaps a surface polar bead for an oily one?

text.en: The fold holds but the protein grows a sticky patch, and in a crowd the copies clump into rods. Surface beads matter when the personality changes.

feedback.en: Polar to polar is one thing. Polar to oily puts an oily patch in the water, and water squeezes it against its neighbours.
The fold is held by the buried core, which the swap did not touch. The fold is fine. The surface is not.
It works exactly as well alone. In a crowd, it sticks to itself, and sticking is the problem.

explanation.en: Ask two questions of any swap. Does it change the bead's personality? Does the bead sit inside or outside? The answers predict which of the three outcomes you get.
